title: Do not require runtime payment OTP for migrations
decisions: The migrate command reads only DATABASE_URL and runs before config.Load, because PAYMENT_OTP is consumed only when composing the runtime payment service.
Normal server startup continues to call config.Load and therefore continues to reject a missing or blank PAYMENT_OTP with ErrMissingPaymentOTP.
Do not add a dummy or CI PAYMENT_OTP to the workflow; command-level separation avoids weakening the runtime secret contract and avoids coupling schema maintenance to payment configuration.
compatibility: No API, persistence, serialization, or model fields change. The migration command becomes usable with its existing DATABASE_URL-only contract; server startup behavior remains unchanged.
